$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs (CI `dependency-audit` job). Entries accept a KNOWN high/critical advisory that either cannot be fixed without a tracked breaking upgrade, or has NO published fix at any version (verify with `npm view <pkg> version` against the advisory's vulnerable range before claiming this — an entry blaming a pending upgrade that would not actually fix it is worse than no entry). Every entry needs: ghsa (the advisory id, any case — one entry can never cover anything else), reason, trackedBy (GitHub issue), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC — an expired entry with a live advisory FAILS the gate; renew only with re-triage). package/severity are optional documentation fields; the gate warns when severity drifts from the live advisory. Policy: docs/security/security-fixes.md § npm audit sweep + CI gate.

entries.reason: ICNS parser infinite-loop DoS in image-size, reachable only through the Metro bundler (dev/build-time, never in the shipped app). NO UPSTREAM FIX EXISTS: the advisory covers <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the newest published version, while metro requires image-size ^1.0.2 in both 0.84.4 (current, via @expo/metro) and 0.87.0 (latest). Measured 2026-08-15 on the Expo SDK 57 upgrade — the SDK bump did NOT clear this, so it can only be resolved by a policy decision, not another upgrade.

JXL/HEIF parser infinite-loop DoS in image-size, same unavoidable Metro build-time chain as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr, and equally unfixable — see that entry for the measurement. Expiry deliberately NOT extended past 2026-11-15: failing closed is what forces #923's decision to be made by a person.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification in node-forge accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements. NO UPSTREAM FIX EXISTS: the advisory covers <=1.4.0 and 1.4.0 is the newest published version (checked 2026-10-02). The only consumers are Expo tooling, @expo/cli and @expo/code-signing-certificates (both ^1.3.3), and apps/mobile configures no Expo Updates code signing. Published against an untouched lockfile; turned dependency-audit red on #3133.

Stack-exhaustion DoS in braces through deeply nested brace patterns. NO UPSTREAM FIX EXISTS: the advisory covers <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the newest published version (checked 2026-10-05). The only consumer is micromatch@4.0.8 (^3.0.3, itself the newest), reached through metro-file-map and @expo/metro-file-map (Metro bundler, build-time) and fast-glob (dev); the newest release of each still requires micromatch ^4. The patterns it expands come from tooling config, not user input, and apps/api does not depend on it. Published against an untouched lockfile; turned dependency-audit red on #3183 and #3189-#3192.
